display.summary: The runtime-volume guard belongs to whichever process writes the volume, so a read-only web mount no longer disables the update card or refuses a manual check.
highlights: Celery records its runtime-volume verdict on the state row; web reads it instead of probing a mount it holds read-only.
Queueing is refused with a named reason when the update worker has not reported for ten minutes.
Deployment Doctor's updater.runtime_volume check reports the writer's verdict, not the local process's mount.
